integrity: Self-contained mathematical proof, reproducible Python finite checks, and accurately distinguished Ehrhart vs normal-fan Gorenstein notions. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Normal-fan toric variety with specified saturated affine lattice; no classification of the singular scheme or full analytic local singularities. Earlier graph-polytope and general 0/1-polytope work may cover some individual corollaries. Undiscovered equivalences possible. Finite exact checks n=6,8 do not prove the full infinite theorem.
source_ids: Edmonds J. Res. Nat. Bur. Standards 69B (1965), 125--130
title: Weil--Cartier gap and canonical non-Cartierness of complete-graph perfect-matching toric varieties
